narrative: Email claiming urgent utility bill payment required to prevent immediate disconnection.

message.body: IMMEDIATE DISCONNECTION NOTICE: Electricity connection will be cut at 8:00 PM due to pending bill of ₹1,820. Pay immediately at http://powerbill-quickpay.org

evidence.label: Official Electricity Utility Portal
evidence.value: Utility portal shows zero outstanding bill; status fully paid.

consequence_text.safe: You checked your utility provider's official portal and confirmed your bill was paid.
consequence_text.unsafe: Paying bills via suspicious link leads to financial theft.

teaching_point: Verify utility bill alerts on the official provider website before making payments.
